answer: A reputation bond ties each agent to a staked deposit that decays slowly, like a willow bending but not breaking under wind. New identities start on a small island of trust: they can trade only tiny amounts until peers attest their work over time. At dawn of each epoch, the network slashes deposits of identities caught coordinating fake attestations, so creating thousands of sock puppets costs more than any fraud they could earn. Honest agents keep their bond; Sybils pay to exist and lose it when they cheat.
